title: Battle triage guidance
hypothesis: Telling the model that RUN is the bottom-right battle option, to run from wild battles when its own active Pokémon is below half HP, and that a POKéMON CENTER nurse or MOM heals the party, with one readout line when its own Pokémon is below half HP, cuts blackouts and wasted wild battles (showcase run 2026-10-16T00-34-26_qwen36-gpu1_show fought 7 wild battles, fled none, walked into grass at 3/23 HP and blacked out by turn 768), so more runs reach ROUTE 103 (graded there: wild battles start on Route 101 and the rival battle waits on Route 103) in fewer turns.
notes: Uses the finals incumbent, as blocked-batch-result does (the switch is omitted there, so it reads OFF). Activation: the system-prompt section is in the model's prompt from the first turn, so the earliest point it can change what the model sees is NEW_GAME_CREATED; the readout lines first appear after the PROF. BIRCH rescue (own party below half HP; RUN is refused in the rescue and no line is shown there). Primary ROUTE_103, as counter-talk uses, because the shared RIVAL_HOUSE_ENTERED comes before any battle. Not yet designed: run pokebench-experiment-design (tier, start state, power-sized N within the operator's GPU-hour budget, overview at docs/experiments/battle-triage-guidance.html) before this entry is queued or driven.
